_comment: Illustrative defaults, not survey-calibrated. gain_w_per_m2 (14 W/m^2) approximates ASHRAE 90.1 Table 9.5.1 grocery-store lighting power density (~0.9 W/ft^2 ~ 9.7 W/m^2) plus an illustrative margin for open refrigerated-display-case equipment load, which LPD alone doesn't capture. Blended with (not replacing) the per-occupant gains -- see core/buem_adapter.py to_buem_profiles().
description: Grocery retail. Open 7 days, extended weekday hours.
